related_questions.snippet: Many people with COVID-19, also called coronavirus disease 2019, recover at home. But for some, COVID-19 can be a serious illness. text_blocks.snippet: While the World Health Organization (WHO) declared an end to the COVID-19 Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 5, 2023, COVID-19 continues to circulate. Currently, COVID-19 vaccines continue to offer protection against severe disease and death according to the WHO.
